name: ESF Summer Camps at Friends Select School
description_short: ESF day camp on the Friends Select School campus in Center City Philadelphia for boys and girls from rising preschool to grade 9. Campers are grouped by grade, swim with Red Cross certified lifeguards and instructors, and pick from more than 60 activities across sports, arts, science, engineering and technology.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel by March 15, 2027 for a refund less the $50 registration fee (a full cancellation also costs $300 per child); from March 16 to June 1, 2027, a credit instead of a refund; no refunds or credits after June 1. An optional protection plan covers injury or illness.
notes: Standard 2027 rates for Junior, Senior and Multi-Sports camps (rising PreS to 9th): 2 weeks $1,390 up to 10 weeks $6,650; early bird until February 1, 2027 is $1,290 for 2 weeks. STEAM specialty camps (rising K to 6) $695 a week standard. Bit by Bit computer science academy (rising 7 to 9) $1,995 for 2 weeks. 5+ weeks save $30 a week. Weeks need not be consecutive. Standard hours 9:00 to 3:00. Club OT extended day is offered after camp. Optional lunch program at extra cost. No camp Friday June 18 or Monday July 5, 2027.
